# Sandbox document capability fixtures

These synthetic fixtures come from `firecrawl/anydoc` tag `v0.2.4`
(commit `42bf1c5ecdde9eb0d96d6bd75a9e6698cf93b14c`) and are used only to
prove local Sandbox parsing capability:

- `tests/fixtures/doc/handmade-cyrillic.doc` → `legacy.doc`
- `tests/fixtures/xls/sheet.xls` → `legacy.xls`
- `tests/fixtures/ppt/handmade-sparsenotes.ppt` → `legacy.ppt`
- `tests/fixtures/pptx/handmade-altpath.pptx` → `modern.pptx`

They are redistributed under that repository's MIT license, reproduced in
`LICENSE.anydoc`. No production or user document content is included.
